text: and its worth noting all of this is clearly reset-able so then what needs to happen is that after every change need to reinforce the state of the model if its just bare, or textured, whatever it is.
resolution: Added a resident model-state transaction guard for metadata-only face merges. It verifies bare or authored-atlas identity, geometry and UV buffers, atlas hash and dimensions, source projection, colors and alpha, materials, visible and hidden part ownership, Outliner ranges, and document identity before commit, rolling back a rejected group update.
